rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for wondering at or being amazed by something.

example.english: I marvel at how such a small machine can make food this good.
example.traditional: 我真係覺得好神奇，咁細部機器竟然可以整到咁好食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 hou2 san4 kei4 gam3 sai3 bou6 gei1 hei3 ging2 jin4 ho2 ji5 zing2 dou3 gam3 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this when marvelling mainly expresses admiration or respect for someone or something.

example.english: I really marvel at him for completing the whole race in such heavy rain.
example.traditional: 我真係佩服佢，咁大風雨都仲堅持跑完全程。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 pui3 fuk6 keoi5 gam3 daai6 fung1 jyu5 dou1 zung6 gin1 ci4 paau2 jyun4 cyun4 cing4

rows.note: Use this when the main idea is surprise or astonishment rather than admiration.

example.english: I marvel at the fact that he moved all the furniture by himself.
example.traditional: 聽到佢一個人搬晒成屋傢俬，我真係覺得好驚訝。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 bun1 saai3 sing4 uk1 gaa1 si1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 hou2 ging1 ngaa6
